title: Finite locally free modules admit an exact pairing with their internal dual
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and M a finite locally free O_X-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Put M^\vee=\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(M,O_X). There exist coevaluation O_X\to M^\vee\otimes M and evaluation M\otimes M^\vee\to O_X satisfying both triangle identities, equivalently an ExactPairing(M^\vee,M).

source.place: Modules, Example 0FNV, canonical coevaluation as inverse image of identity and the two triangle identities.

proof.text: Use the canonical Hom-tensor isomorphism of lem-sc-ext-evaluation, instantiated at N=M. The Lean proof uses its already-proved upstream instance isIso_dualTensorHom_of_isFiniteLocallyFree, without importing the still-open duplicate wrapper Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ExtEvaluation. Identify this morphism with MonoidalClosed.ihomUnitTensorToIhom M M by the comparison bridge.

Apply MonoidalClosed.exactPairingOfIsIso M. This generic categorical construction uses inverse image of the transpose of the right unitor as coevaluation; its proved triangle identities give an exact pairing between the internal dual and M.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Example 0FNV, canonical coevaluation as inverse image of identity and the two triangle identities.
proof_origin.note: Lean uses the existing finite-local-freeness Hom-tensor isomorphism and the proved categorical duality criterion; the remaining bridge is a separate node.
